widgets_values: The image is a black and white illustration of a t-shirt. The shirt is short-sleeved and has a round neckline. It appears to be made of a soft, lightweight fabric. The stripes on the shirt are vertical and run horizontally across the shirt. On the left side of the shirt, there is a small white cup with a black handle. The cup is slightly tilted to the right, as if it is holding something in it. The background is plain white.
如果只需要换上衣，就只选择上衣，如果只换裤子就选择裤子，如果需要衣服跟裤子都换，就选择上衣、短裙、裤子、连衣裙，这四个，建议如果模特是穿着短裤或者短袖，那就只能给他换短裤或者短袖，（长裤换长裤，短裤换短裤）
